div.div: فَنَاةٌ A bull or cow; syn. بَقَرَةٌ; (AA, T, S, M, K;) [i. e.] a بَقَرَة وَحْشِيَة [or wild bull or cow; an antelope of the bovine kind]: so says Aboo-'Alee El-Kálee: (TA:) it occurs in a verse of Lebeed; and is said, as on the authority of IAar, to be قَنَاة, with ق: (TA in art. قنو:) pl. فَنَوَاتٌ (AA, T, S, M, K) and [coll. gen. n.] ↓ فَنًا . (Aboo- 'Alee El-Kálee, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
